findings.title: Deep noncanonical controls can be promoted without branch-local epoch evaluation
findings.reproduction: Evaluate a losing branch whose child names an invalid, excluded, or pending branch-local base head.
findings.closure: Every otherwise-usable retained control is evaluated against its own branch-local accepted state before its final disposition is assigned.

findings.title: Foreign-coordinate chunks can poison a target descriptor
findings.reproduction: Evaluate a valid target descriptor beside a foreign-coordinate chunk that references the target descriptor.
findings.closure: Checkpoint chunks, event identifiers, digest inputs, and work are selected by coordinate plus descriptor.

findings.title: Foreign-coordinate change claims can consume target work
findings.reproduction: Evaluate a target beside foreign-coordinate change events that name its control or share a change hash.
findings.closure: Change claims and carriers are indexed and traversed by coordinate plus control or hash, with exact target budget invariance.

findings.title: Parent-disposition propagation is unmetered and potentially quadratic
findings.reproduction: Propagate a pending or invalid ancestor through a long target control chain under an exact work budget.
findings.closure: A deterministic parent-before-child traversal charges each relevant relationship once and observes cancellation before charged work.

findings.title: Interrupted finalization reports unexplained remainder as consumed work
findings.reproduction: Interrupt after reservation but before most finalization work and inspect each permit dimension.
findings.closure: Every reserved dimension is settled exactly once as consumed, refunded, or deliberately forfeited.

findings.title: The externally authored NIP is not locally reconciled
findings.reproduction: Compare the read-only NIP with interoperability-critical companion rules.
findings.closure: The implementation-owned companion and a portable reconciliation delta remain complete while the NIP itself stays outside this repository's implementation scope.

findings.title: The signed corpus and evidence matrix omit follow-up compositions
findings.reproduction: Exercise branch-local invalid frontiers, foreign references, exact isolation budgets, propagation, and finalization settlement.
findings.closure: Distribution v8 contains 171 scenarios and the 129-row registry binds exact cross-language and local proof.
